arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

SKILL = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), ".codex", "skills", "creating-financial-models")
sys.path.insert(0, SKILL)
from dcf_model import DCFModel
from sensitivity_analysis import SensitivityAnalyzer

OUT = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "model_outputs")
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

PROJ = 5
SHARES = 45.0
NET_DEBT = 250.0 - 40.0

model = DCFModel("Northwind Analytics, Inc.")
model.set_historical_financials(
    revenue=[820, 980, 1180, 1420],
    ebitda=[172, 206, 260, 326],
    capex=[41, 49, 59, 71],
    nwc=[90, 108, 130, 156],
    years=[2021, 2022, 2023, 2024],
)
BASE_MARGIN = 0.25
model.set_assumptions(
    projection_years=PROJ,
    revenue_growth=[0.18, 0.15, 0.12, 0.10, 0.08],
    ebitda_margin=[0.235, 0.24, 0.245, 0.25, BASE_MARGIN],
    tax_rate=0.22,
    capex_percent=[0.05] * PROJ,
    nwc_percent=[0.11] * PROJ,
    terminal_growth=0.03,
)
base_wacc = model.calculate_wacc(
    risk_free_rate=0.042, beta=1.15, market_premium=0.065,
    cost_of_debt=0.055, debt_to_equity=0.45,
)
print("WACC = %.2f%%  (Ke=%.2f%%, Kd(at)=%.2f%%)" % (
    base_wacc*100, model.wacc_components["cost_of_equity"]*100,
    0.055*(1-0.22)*100))

model.project_cash_flows()
primary = model.calculate_enterprise_value(terminal_method="growth")
multi   = model.calculate_enterprise_value(terminal_method="multiple", exit_multiple=9.5)
model.calculate_equity_value(net_debt=NET_DEBT, shares_outstanding=SHARES)

print()
print(model.generate_summary())

proj_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "Year": ["Y%d" % i for i in range(1, PROJ+1)],
    "Revenue": ["%.1f" % v for v in model.projections["revenue"]],
    "EBITDA": ["%.1f" % v for v in model.projections["ebitda"]],
    "EBIT": ["%.1f" % v for v in model.projections["ebit"]],
    "NOPAT": ["%.1f" % v for v in model.projections["nopat"]],
    "Capex": ["%.1f" % v for v in model.projections["capex"]],
    "NWC_Change": ["%.1f" % v for v in model.projections["nwc_change"]],
    "FCF": ["%.1f" % v for v in model.projections["fcf"]],
})
proj_df.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "cash_flow_projections.csv"), index=False)
print("\n=== PROJECTED CASH FLOWS ($M) ===")
print(proj_df.to_string(index=False))

wacc_range = [0.075, 0.085, 0.095, 0.105, 0.115]
growth_range = [0.015, 0.02, 0.025, 0.03, 0.035, 0.04]
grid = model.sensitivity_analysis("wacc", wacc_range, "growth", growth_range)
sens = pd.DataFrame(grid, index=["WACC %.1f%%" % (v*100) for v in wacc_range],
                    columns=["g %.1f%%" % (v*100) for v in growth_range])
sens.index.name = "EV ($M)"
sens.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "sensitivity_wacc_growth.csv"))
print("\n=== TWO-WAY SENSITIVITY: EV ($M), WACC x terminal growth ===")
print(sens.round(0).to_string())

analyzer = SensitivityAnalyzer(model)
def get_ev():
    model.project_cash_flows()
    return model.calculate_enterprise_value(terminal_method="growth")["enterprise_value"]
def sw(v): model.wacc_components["wacc"] = v
def st(v): model.assumptions["terminal_growth"] = v
def sm(v): model.assumptions["ebitda_margin"] = [v]*PROJ
def sc(v): model.assumptions["capex_percent"] = [v]*PROJ
def sr(v): model.assumptions["revenue_growth"] = [v]*PROJ

tornado = analyzer.tornado_analysis({
    "Terminal growth": {"base": 0.03, "low": 0.02, "high": 0.04, "update_func": st},
    "WACC": {"base": base_wacc, "low": base_wacc-0.015, "high": base_wacc+0.015, "update_func": sw},
    "EBITDA margin": {"base": BASE_MARGIN, "low": 0.20, "high": 0.30, "update_func": sm},
    "Capex % rev": {"base": 0.05, "low": 0.03, "high": 0.08, "update_func": sc},
    "Revenue growth": {"base": 0.10, "low": 0.05, "high": 0.16, "update_func": sr},
}, get_ev)
t_out = tornado[["variable", "base_value", "low_value", "high_value", "low_output", "high_output", "impact", "impact_pct"]]
t_out.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "tornado_analysis.csv"), index=False)
print("\n=== TORNADO (impact on EV, $M) ===")
print(t_out.round(1).to_string(index=False))

sw(base_wacc); st(0.03); sm(BASE_MARGIN); sc(0.05); sr(0.10)

scen = analyzer.scenario_analysis(
    {"Bear": {"wacc": base_wacc+0.03, "tg": 0.015, "margin": 0.18, "rev_growth": 0.03},
     "Base": {"wacc": base_wacc, "tg": 0.03, "margin": BASE_MARGIN, "rev_growth": 0.10},
     "Bull": {"wacc": base_wacc-0.02, "tg": 0.04, "margin": 0.32, "rev_growth": 0.16}},
    {"wacc": sw, "tg": st, "margin": sm, "rev_growth": sr}, get_ev,
    {"Bear": 0.25, "Base": 0.50, "Bull": 0.25})
scen["Equity_value"] = scen["output"] - NET_DEBT
scen["Value_per_share"] = scen["Equity_value"] / SHARES
scen.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT, "scenario_plan.csv"), index=False)
print("\n=== SCENARIO PLAN ===")
print(scen[["scenario", "probability", "output", "Equity_value", "Value_per_share", "weighted_output"]].round(2).to_string(index=False))

sw(base_wacc); st(0.03); sm(BASE_MARGIN); sc(0.05); sr(0.10)

def per_share():
    model.project_cash_flows()
    ev = model.calculate_enterprise_value(terminal_method="growth")["enterprise_value"]
    return (ev - NET_DEBT) / SHARES

be = analyzer.breakeven_analysis("WACC", sw, per_share, 95.0, 0.04, 0.25, 0.0005)
print("\n=== BREAKEVEN ===")
print("WACC needed for $95.00/share target: %.2f%%" % (be*100))
sw(base_wacc)

fcfs = np.array(model.projections["fcf"])
checks = [
    ("All projected FCF positive", bool((fcfs > 0).all())),
    ("EV falls as WACC rises (monotonic)", all(grid[i,0] >= grid[i+1,0] for i in range(len(wacc_range)-1))),
    ("EV rises with terminal growth", all(grid[-1,j] <= grid[-1,j+1] for j in range(len(growth_range)-1))),
    ("Terminal value 50-90% of EV", 50 <= primary["terminal_percent"] <= 90),
    ("Terminal growth < WACC", 0.03 < base_wacc),
]
print("\n=== QUALITY CHECKS ===")
for n, ok in checks:
    print("  [%s] %s" % ("PASS" if ok else "FAIL", n))

report = []
report.append(model.generate_summary())
report.append("=" * 52)
report.append("CROSS-CHECK: exit-multiple terminal value (9.5x EV/EBITDA)")
report.append("  EV (exit multiple) = $%.0fM   |   EV (perpetuity growth) = $%.0fM"
              % (multi["enterprise_value"], primary["enterprise_value"]))
report.append("  Equity value = $%.0fM   |   Value/share = $%.2f"
              % (primary["enterprise_value"]-NET_DEBT, (primary["enterprise_value"]-NET_DEBT)/SHARES))
report.append("")
report.append("TWO-WAY SENSITIVITY TABLE (EV $M)")
report.append(sens.round(0).to_string())
report.append("")
report.append("TORNADO RANKING")
report.append(t_out.round(1).to_string(index=False))
report.append("")
report.append("SCENARIO PLAN")
report.append(scen[["scenario","probability","output","Equity_value","Value_per_share","weighted_output"]].round(2).to_string(index=False))
report.append("")
report.append("BREAKEVEN WACC for $95/share: %.2f%%" % (be*100))
for n, ok in checks:
    report.append("  [%s] %s" % ("PASS" if ok else "FAIL", n))
with open(os.path.join(OUT, "valuation_report.txt"), "w") as f:
    f.write("\n".join(report))

print("\n=== OUTPUT FILES ===")
for f in sorted(os.listdir(OUT)):
    print("  model_outputs/%s" % f)
PY
